# ModSIM x64 IFX Port — Session Notes

## Background

ModSIM is a mineral processing plant simulator whose engine is a Windows DLL
(`Modsim.dll`) originally built with **Digital Visual Fortran (CVF) 6.6** and
linked against the 32-bit **IMSL** numerical library. The goal of this porting
effort was to rebuild the engine as a 64-bit DLL using **Intel IFX (oneAPI
2025.3)** on VS2022, without IMSL.

---

## Previous Session — Completed Work

| Item | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Identified that IFX requires both `vcvarsall.bat x64` AND `compiler\env\vars.bat intel64` | Fixed; documented |
| Fixed all Fortran compile errors across ModsimMain sources | Done |
| Removed `/warn:interfaces` (too many legacy implicit-type mismatches) | Done |
| Removed IMSL link libs from `ModsimMain_ifx.mak` | Done |
| Replaced `BETAI`, `DBETAI`, `ANORDF` in `BETAAMD.FOR` with pure-Fortran implementations | Lentz continued-fraction + `erfc`-based normal CDF |
| **`Modsim.dll` builds — exit 0, 5.0 MB** | Done |
| Fixed `UserModels` C++/Fortran linkage (`extern "C"`, DLLEXPORT alias) | Done |
| **`UserModels.dll` builds — exit 0** | Done |
| Created `NumericalReplace.f90` — pure-Fortran/MKL stubs replacing all IMSL calls | Done |
| Created `minpack.f90` — public-domain MINPACK LM routines | Done |
| Dropped `USE Numerical_libraries` from `ModsimCurveFit.f90`; updated call signatures | Done |
| **`ModsimCurveFit.dll` builds — exit 0, 11.4 MB** | Done |

Key constraint: IMSL libs at `C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\DF98\IMSL\LIB\`
are 32-bit x86 (`IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_I386 = 0x14C`) and cannot be linked into a
64-bit (`0x8664`) binary. All IMSL functionality was replaced in-source.

## This Session

### 1. Reorganised build artefacts

- Moved `BUILD_REPORT.md` from repo root → `docs/build/BUILD_REPORT.md`
- Recreated `build.bat`, `build_usermodels.bat`, `build_curvefit.bat` in
  `docs/build/` (original temp copies were lost when the session ended)
- Updated `BUILD_REPORT.md` to reference the new paths

### 2. Verified `ModsimMain_ifx.mak` against original `ModsimMain.mak`

Compared the IFX makefile against the DVF-generated `ModsimMain.mak`
(originally auto-generated by VS6 / Digital Visual Fortran).

**Findings — all differences are intentional:**

| Change | Reason |
|---|---|
| `df.exe` → `ifx.exe` | Compiler swap |
| `/machine:I386` → `/machine:X64` | 64-bit target |
| `imsl.lib IMSLMPISTUB.LIB IMSLS_ERR.LIB` removed | IMSL is 32-bit only |
| `/warn:argument_checking` removed | Suppresses hundreds of legacy implicit-type warnings |
| `SIMOPMOD.F90` added to compile + link lists | `Simop.for` uses `USE SimopModule`; DVF resolved this implicitly, IFX requires it explicit |
| `UserModels\Debug\` used for both configs in original → fixed | Original `.mak` had a copy-paste bug; IFX mak uses Release/Debug correctly |
| `.sbr` browser files not generated | DVF-specific; no IFX equivalent needed |

Note: the repo `MAKEFILE` (in `Modsimdl/`) is **not** a build-all makefile —
it only auto-generates `dminp.for`, `report.for`, and `pphi5.for` by running
the `DIMINP.FOR` and `PARSET.FOR` programs. The DLL build was always driven
by the VS6 `.dsp` / NMAKE `.mak` files.

### 3. Created `ModsimCurveFit_ifx.mak`

Location: `Modsim/Modsimdl/ModsimCurveFitDll/ModsimCurveFit_ifx.mak`

- Replaces the hand-rolled `build_curvefit.bat`
- Adds `NumericalReplace.f90` and `minpack.f90` to the build (not present in
  the original `ModsimCurveFit.mak`)
- Links MKL static libs (`mkl_intel_lp64`, `mkl_sequential`, `mkl_core`)
- Output to `Debug_ifx\` / `Release_ifx\` to avoid clobbering old CVF `Debug\`

Compilation order enforced via explicit dependencies:

```
GLOBALS.F90 → WorkingCommon.f90 → NumericalReplace.f90
           → minpack.f90 → Modelresponse.f90 → ModsimCurveFit.f90
```

### 4. Created `UserModels_ifx.mak`

Location: `Modsim/Modsimdl/UserModels/UserModels_ifx.mak`

- Mixed IFX (Fortran) + `cl.exe` (C++) build — mirrors what the old `.dsp` did
- `ConnectorToC.cpp` compiled with `cl.exe`; all `.f90` with `ifx.exe`
- Module dependency order: `GLOBALS.F90` → `ModelVariables.f90` →
  `Utilities.f90` → `UserModels.f90` → `Connector.f90`
- Output to existing `Debug\` / `Release\` directories (matches what
  `ModsimMain_ifx.mak` expects when linking `UserModels.lib`)

### 5. Verified `Modsim.dll` clean rebuild

Ran `NMAKE CLEAN` then a full rebuild from `ModsimMain/`:

```

```

- **Exit code:** 0
- **Output:** `Modsim.dll` — 5,043,200 bytes, 09/06/2026
- **Diagnostics:** `remark #8291` (FORMAT field-width advisory) and

## Toolchain

```
Compiler : Intel IFX 2025.3.2 (oneAPI)
Linker   : MSVC link.exe (VS2022 17.x)
C++      : cl.exe (VS2022, for ConnectorToC.cpp in UserModels)
MKL      : N:\Program Files (x86)\Intel\oneAPI\mkl\2025.3\lib\
             mkl_intel_lp64.lib  mkl_sequential.lib  mkl_core.lib
Target   : x64 (IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_AMD64)
```

Environment must be initialised before running NMAKE:
```bat
call "N:\...\vcvarsall.bat" x64
call "N:\...\compiler\2025.3\env\vars.bat" intel64
```

---

## Session 3 — GNUmakefile extended to all three DLLs

### Work done

- Extended `GNUmakefile` to build all three DLLs from a single `make` invocation.
- Each DLL compiles `GLOBALS.F90` (and other shared modules) into its own
  per-DLL subdirectory (`build/ifx/debug/UserModels/`, `build/ifx/debug/CurveFit/`)
  so that `-module:` paths are isolated and .mod files do not collide.
- Build order enforced by make dependencies: UserModels → ModsimMain → CurveFit.
- Discovered that `vcvarsall.bat` must be called from the **N: drive** installation
  (`N:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\...`), not `C:\Program Files\...`.
  Without the correct MSVC environment, IFX loads wrong DLL versions and crashes
  with `STATUS_HEAP_CORRUPTION` (0xC0000374 from ntdll.dll) on every invocation.
- Discovered that `setvars.bat` (not the per-component `vars.bat`) must be used
  to set up the full oneAPI environment including MKL. Without it, MKL lib
  directory is not on `LIB` and `ModsimCurveFit` fails to link.
- Created `docs/build/build_all_gnu.bat` — thin wrapper that sets up the correct
  environment and calls `make COMPILER=ifx BUILD=debug all`.

### Verified build results (09/07/2026)

| DLL | Size | Exit |
|---|---|---|
| `build/ifx/debug/UserModels.dll` | 1,251,840 bytes | 0 |
| `build/ifx/debug/ModsimMain.dll` | 5,043,200 bytes | 0 |
| `build/ifx/debug/ModsimCurveFit.dll` | 9,490,432 bytes | 0 |

### Environment setup (corrected)

```bat
call "N:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Community\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvarsall.bat" x64
call "N:\Program Files (x86)\Intel\oneAPI\setvars.bat" intel64
```

`setvars.bat` is preferred over `compiler\2025.3\env\vars.bat` because it also
adds the MKL lib directory to `LIB` (needed for ModsimCurveFit link step).
